thread:
emily: Quick note 3 - we saw a burst of rejects from function payments.process when the strict schema switch hit. Ops only noticed after a customer call.
raj: Which validation errors?
emily: Mostly type mismatches and unexpected nested fields in tool response. Small sample: ```json
{"id":"tx_42","amount_cents":"3000","card":{"last4":1234,"auth_meta":{"risk_score": 0.2}}}
``` validator expected amount_cents int and last4 string, and auth_meta is unknown.
tom: Ouch. That extra nested auth_meta is what triggers strict reject under the function/tool contract.
nina: Short term: flip billing to non-billable for validation.rejected during canary windows so customers don't see noise. I'll open a billing request.
emily: Long term: two proposals: 1) run a 24h shadow compatibility check (replay sampled traffic into the strict validator and surface top diffs per integrator) 2) implement best-effort coercion rules (number->string for last4, float->int cents when lossless) but tag those as "lenient_coerce" in traces.
raj: I like both. Shadow-run prevents surprises. For coercion, define exact rules to avoid silent data corruption. Any coercion must emit coercion.type and coercion.summary in the trace.
tom: Console needs a tiny payload-diff viewer in the route page showing expected schema vs actual and a one-click "share sample with integrator" (sanitized). Also show a per-request badge: validation=(ok|lenient_coerce|rejected).
nina: Sampling: current uniform sampling misses low-rate rejects. Propose adaptive sampling: base 0.5%, ramp to 50% when rejects/min > 5 for 10min, cap stored samples to 500/min.
emily: Good. Ops alert: if lenient_coerce_rate > 3% over 30m, send to #eng-platform-ops and increase sampling automatically.
raj: I'll draft a tiny decision table PR for the validator with three outcomes and per-route strict_level (lenient/strict): 
- MISSING_REQUIRED -> reject
- TYPE_MISMATCH -> try coercion if lossless, tag lenient_coerce, else reject
- EXTRA_FIELDS -> allow in lenient mode, capture diff
Will include tests for payments.process.
tom: I'll start a Console ticket for the diff UI + replay (with opt-in for PII).
nina: Billing ticket opened and tagged finance-infra. ops-bot: Created incident note ID #INC-8921 and linked this thread.
emily: Action list recap: raj -> validator PR + tests + coercion logging, tom -> Console ticket and mock, nina -> billing ticket and alert rule, emily -> run shadow sampling job and share results. Ping if you see more rejects (include sample id). :thumbsup:
